thread:
maya: Quick sync — final public launch readiness check. Need owners to confirm SLA, docs, support rota, monitoring, pricing exposure. Target launch next Tue. Ping owners please.
aj: SLA proposal: 99.9% uptime, p95 gen < 120ms, p99 < 400ms. Error budget: 0.1% monthly. Is that what we lock? Also need explicit rollback/backoff wording.
tom: +1 on 99.9. Suggest fallback policy: route to lower-cost model variant + reduce max_tokens on burst, plus automatic circuit-breaker. I'll draft the policy.
seema: Docs: will own SDK quickstart updates (node/python), migration note for quantized models, and a short changelog. ETA Fri EOD for first pass.
aj: Support: recommend 72h double-coverage post-launch (two engineers per 12h window) and a temporary "launch-pager" channel. Escalation path: oncall -> infra -> eng-sre lead. I'll post rota once confirmed.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created for 2023-11-07T02:00Z. Auto-rollback engineered: if 5% error rate sustained for 10m.
maya: Monitoring checklist ask: token error rate alert (>0.5% sustained 5m), latency p95 alert (>150ms sustained 10m), cache hit rate drop (>20% absolute drop). Need owner for dashboards + runbooks.
tom: I'll own latency/throughput dashboards and seqlen heatmap. Adding model-variant-fallback counters and a 'fallback-trigger' metric. Will add runbook snippets for investigating cache drops and cold-starts.
aj: Pricing readiness: publish cost envelope (typical RU, tail RU), rate-limit tiers, and quota rules for freemium. Need FinOps sign-off before public page goes live.
seema: I'll coordinate pricing copy with FinOps and Marketing. Draft for pricing page + one-pager for AE/CS. Also adding a small FAQ about Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private.
maya: Open risks: burst autoscale billing, silent model regressions, malicious/high-rate clients. Actions: Tom -> fallback policy + playbook; Seema -> docs + pricing copy; Aj -> support rota + SLA language; Maya -> launch announcement and legal checklist. Please ack.
tom: Action: creating playbook PR with config snippets (circuit-breaker, autoscale knobs, fallback mapping). Example config snippet I'm adding to PR:
```yaml
circuit_breaker:
  error_threshold: 0.05 # 5%
  window: 600s
  cooldown: 900s
fallback_map:
  - condition: queue_depth > 1000
    action: route_to: model-small-v2
    max_tokens: 256
```
PR: https://git.internal/docs/pull/4821 (will link runbook).
seema: I'll draft the 1-page "what to tell customers" for AE/CS and a short migration note for existing Dedicated customers. Expect first draft tomorrow.
aj: I'll post the 72h rota to #oncall and pin a condensed SLA blurb. Also building a CS FAQ with top 10 questions and canned responses.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Burn-in smoke tests scheduled for 2023-11-05T10:00Z (load: 100 rps sustained 15m). Alerts will fire to #launch-run and launch-pager.
maya: :thumbsup: Collecting owner confirmations by EOD Wed. If no objections, we lock the committal and publish the launch page. If you need scope changes, flag them now so we can triage.
aj: Acked. I'll post rota + SLA blurb before EOD Wed.
tom: Acked. Will open playbook PR in next 3 hours.
seema: Acked. Drafting pricing copy now.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Note — keep monitoring retention at 14d for launch period to expedite triage.
maya: Thanks all. We'll reconvene Thu AM if any blockers pop up.
